These are all carnivores! Dinosaurs that eat meat!
Carnivores are meat eaters! They hunted other animals!
You found the meat-eating dinosaurs! They had sharp teeth!
These are all herbivores! Dinosaurs that eat plants!
Plant eaters! They loved leaves and grass!
Herbivores are gentle giants that only ate plants!
These all swam in the ocean! They're marine reptiles!
Sea creatures from long ago! They lived in water!
These prehistoric animals ruled the ancient seas!
These could all fly! They're called pterosaurs!
Flying reptiles! They soared through the sky!
These had wings and could fly like birds!
These are all birds! They have feathers and beaks!
Birds! Some can fly, some can't, but they all have feathers!
You found the birds! They lay eggs and have wings!
These are all mammals! They have fur and drink milk as babies!
Mammals! Warm-blooded animals with hair or fur!
Furry friends! Mammals take care of their babies!
These are all insects! They have six legs!
Insects! Tiny creatures with six legs and antennae!
You found the bugs! All insects have six legs!
These are all fish! They breathe underwater with gills!
Fish! They swim in water and have scales!
Splish splash! These all live and swim in water!
These all help us travel! They're vehicles!
Transportation! Things that take us places!
Zoom zoom! These all help people get around!
These are all toys! Things kids play with!
Playtime! These are all fun toys!
Toys for playing! Everyone loves toys!
These are all plants! They grow from the ground!
Plants! They need sun and water to grow!
Green and growing! Plants make oxygen for us!
These birds can't fly! But they're still amazing!
Flightless birds! They walk or swim instead of fly!
Not all birds fly! These ones stay on the ground!
These are big cats! Powerful hunters!
Big cats! Like house cats but much bigger and stronger!
Roar! These big cats are the kings of the jungle!
This is the Titanoboa! The biggest snake ever!
A giant prehistoric snake! It was longer than a school bus!
These are all flowers! Beautiful and colorful!
Pretty flowers! They smell nice and attract bees!
Blooming beauties! Flowers come in many colors!
These all travel on land! Cars, bikes, and more!
Land vehicles! They use roads and streets!
These are all prehistoric! They lived millions of years ago!
Ancient creatures! They roamed the Earth long before people!
From long, long ago! These animals are now extinct!
Allosaurus was a fierce meat-eating dinosaur! It had sharp claws and teeth!
The Allosaurus lived about 150 million years ago!
Allosaurus means different lizard! It was a fast hunter!
Allosaurus is not a plant eater! It had sharp teeth for eating meat!
Allosaurus lived on land, not in the water!
Allosaurus couldn't fly! It walked on two strong legs!
Ankylosaurus was covered in armor like a tank!
This dinosaur had a club at the end of its tail for protection!
Ankylosaurus only ate plants even though it looked tough!
Ankylosaurus didn't eat meat! It was a gentle plant eater!
Ankylosaurus lived on land, not in the ocean!
Ankylosaurus was too heavy to fly! It stayed on the ground!
Archaeopteryx had feathers like a bird but teeth like a dinosaur!
Scientists call Archaeopteryx the first bird!
Archaeopteryx could probably fly short distances!
Archaeopteryx ate small animals, not plants!
Archaeopteryx lived on land and flew in the air, not in water!
Brachiosaurus was one of the tallest dinosaurs ever!
This gentle giant could reach leaves at the very top of trees!
Brachiosaurus was as tall as a four-story building!
Brachiosaurus didn't eat meat! It loved eating leaves from tall trees!
Brachiosaurus walked on land! It was too big for the water!
Brachiosaurus was way too big and heavy to fly!
Ceratosaurus had a horn on its nose!
This meat-eater was a skilled hunter!
Ceratosaurus means horned lizard!
Ceratosaurus was a meat eater with sharp teeth!
Ceratosaurus hunted on land, not in water!
Ceratosaurus walked on two legs but couldn't fly!
Elasmosaurus had the longest neck of any sea creature!
This marine reptile swam in ancient oceans!
Elasmosaurus used its long neck to catch fish!
Elasmosaurus lived in the ocean, not on land!
Elasmosaurus couldn't fly! It swam in the sea!
Elasmosaurus ate fish and other sea creatures!
Giganotosaurus was even bigger than T-Rex!
This giant hunter lived in South America!
Giganotosaurus means giant southern lizard!
Giganotosaurus was a fierce meat eater!
Giganotosaurus lived on land, not in water!
This huge dinosaur couldn't fly!
Ichthyosaurus looked like a dolphin but was a reptile!
This speedy swimmer lived in ancient seas!
Ichthyosaurus means fish lizard!
Ichthyosaurus couldn't walk on land! It only swam!
Ichthyosaurus swam, it didn't fly!
Ichthyosaurus looked like a fish but was actually a reptile!
Iguanodon had spiky thumbs for protection!
This plant eater could walk on two or four legs!
Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs ever discovered!
Iguanodon only ate plants! It was a herbivore!
Iguanodon lived on land, not in water!
Iguanodon couldn't fly! It stayed on the ground!
Kronosaurus was a powerful ocean hunter!
This sea monster had huge jaws and sharp teeth!
Kronosaurus was named after a Greek god!
Kronosaurus lived in the ocean, not on land!
Kronosaurus couldn't fly! It was a swimmer!
Kronosaurus was a fierce meat eater!
Liopleurodon was one of the biggest ocean predators!
This giant had four flippers for swimming!
Liopleurodon could smell prey from far away!
Liopleurodon only lived in the ocean!
Liopleurodon swam in the sea, it couldn't fly!
Liopleurodon ate fish and other sea creatures!
Microraptor had four wings and could glide!
This tiny dinosaur was covered in feathers!
Microraptor was only about the size of a chicken!
Microraptor ate small animals and insects!
Microraptor lived in trees, not in water!
Mosasaurus was the king of the ancient seas!
This giant lizard swam faster than most fish!
Mosasaurus could swallow sharks whole!
Mosasaurus only lived in the ocean!
Mosasaurus couldn't fly! It was a swimmer!
Mosasaurus was a fierce hunter that ate meat!
Parasaurolophus had a long crest on its head!
This dinosaur could make loud sounds with its crest!
Parasaurolophus was a gentle plant eater!
Parasaurolophus didn't eat meat! It loved plants!
Parasaurolophus lived on land, not in water!
Parasaurolophus couldn't fly! It walked on the ground!
Plesiosaurus had a very long neck and small head!
This sea creature used flippers to swim!
Some people think Plesiosaurus is the Loch Ness Monster!
Plesiosaurus lived in the ocean, not on land!
Plesiosaurus swam in the sea, it couldn't fly!
Plesiosaurus ate fish and squid!
Pteranodon had a wingspan as wide as a small airplane!
This flying reptile had no teeth!
Pteranodon caught fish from the ocean!
Pteranodon flew in the sky! It didn't walk much!
Pteranodon flew over the water but didn't live in it!
Pteranodon looks like a bird but it's actually a reptile!
Pterodactyl means winged finger!
This flying reptile had a long crest on its head!
Pterodactyls were some of the first creatures to fly!
Pterodactyl is not a bird! It's a flying reptile!
Pterodactyl flew in the sky, not in water!
Quetzalcoatlus was the biggest flying animal ever!
It was as tall as a giraffe when standing!
This giant could fly long distances!
Quetzalcoatlus was a reptile, not a bird!
Quetzalcoatlus flew in the air, not in water!
Rhamphorhynchus had a long tail with a diamond shape at the end!
This flying reptile had sharp teeth for catching fish!
Rhamphorhynchus was smaller than most pterosaurs!
Rhamphorhynchus is a reptile, not a bird!
Rhamphorhynchus flew over water but lived on land!
Stegosaurus had big plates on its back!
This dinosaur had a tiny brain the size of a walnut!
Stegosaurus used its spiked tail to fight enemies!
Stegosaurus was a plant eater! Not a meat eater!
Stegosaurus lived on land, not in water!
Stegosaurus was too heavy to fly!
Titanoboa was the biggest snake that ever lived!
This giant snake was longer than a school bus!
Titanoboa lived in swamps and rivers!
Titanoboa lived in rivers, not the ocean!
Snakes can't fly! Titanoboa slithered on land!
T-Rex was the king of the dinosaurs!
T-Rex had tiny arms but a huge, powerful jaw!
T-Rex could eat 500 pounds of meat in one bite!
T-Rex means tyrant lizard king!
T-Rex was a meat eater with the strongest bite ever!
T-Rex lived on land, not in water!
T-Rex couldn't fly! It walked on two big legs!
Triceratops had three horns on its face!
This dinosaur had a big frill to protect its neck!
Triceratops means three-horned face!
Triceratops only ate plants! It was a herbivore!
Triceratops lived on land, not in water!
Triceratops was too heavy to fly!
Utahraptor was one of the biggest raptors!
This dinosaur had a huge claw on each foot!
Utahraptor was smart and hunted in groups!
Utahraptor was a meat eater! A fierce hunter!
Utahraptor lived on land, not in water!
Utahraptor couldn't fly! It ran very fast instead!
Velociraptor was a super fast and smart dinosaur!
This dinosaur was actually covered in feathers!
Velociraptor was only about the size of a turkey!
Velociraptor was a meat eater!
Velociraptor lived on land, not in water!
Velociraptor had feathers but couldn't really fly!
Eagles are powerful birds of prey!
Eagles have amazing eyesight! They can see fish from high up!
The bald eagle is a symbol of the United States!
Eagles are birds, not mammals! They lay eggs!
Eagles are birds! They have feathers, not antennae!
Ostriches are the biggest birds in the world!
Ostriches can't fly but they can run very fast!
Ostrich eggs are the biggest eggs of any bird!
Ostriches can't fly! But they can run really fast!
Ostriches are birds! They have feathers and lay eggs!
Parrots can learn to talk and copy sounds!
Parrots love eating seeds, nuts, and fruit!
Parrots come in many beautiful colors!
Parrots are birds! They have feathers and beaks!
Parrots are birds, not insects!
Penguins are birds that can't fly but swim like champions!
Penguins live in cold places and keep warm in groups!
Penguin dads keep the eggs warm on their feet!
Penguins can't fly! They use their wings to swim!
Penguins are birds! They lay eggs!
Penguins look like fish underwater, but they're birds!
Bears are big and strong mammals!
Some bears sleep all winter! That's called hibernation!
Bears love eating honey, fish, and berries!
Bears are mammals with fur, not birds with feathers!
Bears eat fish but they're not fish! They're mammals!
Elephants are the biggest land animals!
Elephants use their trunks like hands to grab things!
Elephants are very smart and have great memories!
Elephants are mammals! They can't fly!
Elephants live on land! They're mammals, not fish!
Kangaroos hop instead of walk!
Baby kangaroos live in their mommy's pouch!
Kangaroos can jump very far and very high!
Kangaroos are mammals! They have fur and pouches!
Kangaroos can't fly! They hop on strong legs!
Lions are called the king of the jungle!
Male lions have big fluffy manes around their faces!
Lions live in groups called prides!
Lions are big cats! They have fur, not feathers!
Lions live on land! They're not fish!
Tigers have orange fur with black stripes!
Every tiger has unique stripes, like fingerprints!
Tigers are the biggest cats in the world!
Tigers are mammals! Big cats with stripes!
Tigers can swim but they're not fish!
Ants are tiny but super strong! They can carry things many times their weight!
Ants live in big groups called colonies!
All insects have six legs, and ants are insects!
Ants are insects, not birds! They have six legs!
Ants are insects! They're very different from mammals!
Bees make sweet honey!
Bees help flowers grow by carrying pollen!
Bees do a special dance to tell other bees where food is!
Bees are insects! They have six legs and antennae!
Bees are tiny insects, not mammals!
Beetles have hard shell-like wings!
There are more types of beetles than any other insect!
Beetles can be many colors, even shiny!
Beetles are insects with six legs, not birds!
Beetles are small insects, not mammals!
Butterflies start life as caterpillars!
Butterflies have beautiful colorful wings!
Butterflies drink nectar from flowers!
Butterflies are insects! They have six legs, not two!
Butterflies are insects, not mammals!
Goldfish are popular pets!
Goldfish can remember things for months!
Goldfish breathe underwater using gills!
Goldfish are fish! They breathe in water!
Goldfish swim, they don't fly! They're fish!
Salmon swim upstream to lay their eggs!
Salmon can live in both rivers and oceans!
Salmon is a healthy food with lots of good oils!
Salmon are fish! They have scales and gills!
Salmon swim in water! They're fish, not birds!
Sharks have been around since before the dinosaurs!
Sharks can smell blood from very far away!
Sharks keep growing new teeth their whole life!
Sharks are fish! They breathe with gills!
Sharks live in the ocean! They're fish, not birds!
Tuna are super fast swimmers!
Tuna can weigh as much as a car!
Tuna travel in big groups called schools!
Tuna are fish! They have fins and scales!
Tuna swim in the sea! They're fish!
Airplanes fly high in the sky!
Airplanes help people travel to faraway places fast!
Airplanes have wings to help them fly!
An airplane is a machine, not an animal!
Airplanes are vehicles! They're not alive!
Bicycles have two wheels!
You pedal with your feet to make a bicycle go!
Riding a bicycle is great exercise!
A bicycle is something you ride, not an animal!
Bicycles are not alive! They're vehicles!
Cars have four wheels and an engine!
Cars drive on roads and streets!
Cars help families go places together!
A car is a machine, not an animal!
Cars are vehicles! They need gas or electricity!
Trains run on special tracks called railways!
Trains can carry many people at once!
Choo choo! Trains make fun sounds!
A train is a vehicle, not an animal!
Trains are machines that run on tracks!
Dolls are fun toys to play with!
You can dress up dolls in different clothes!
Dolls can be your pretend friends!
A doll is a toy, not a real animal or person!
Dolls are toys! They're not alive!
Puzzles are fun brain games!
You put puzzle pieces together to make a picture!
Puzzles help you think and solve problems!
A puzzle is a game, not an animal!
Puzzles are toys! They're not alive!
Robots are machines that can do tasks!
Some robots can walk and talk!
Robots are powered by electricity or batteries!
A robot is a machine, not an animal!
Robots are built by people! They're not alive!
Teddy bears are soft and cuddly toys!
Teddy bears are named after President Theodore Roosevelt!
Teddy bears are great for hugs!
A teddy bear is a stuffed toy, not a real bear!
Teddy bears are toys! They're not alive!
Daffodils are bright yellow spring flowers!
Daffodils grow from bulbs in the ground!
Daffodils are one of the first flowers to bloom in spring!
A daffodil is a flower, not an animal!
Daisies have white petals and yellow centers!
Daisies grow in fields and gardens!
You can make daisy chains with these flowers!
A daisy is a flower, not an animal!
Oak trees can live for hundreds of years!
Acorns come from oak trees!
Oak trees give us shade and wood!
An oak is a tree, not an animal!
Tulsi is also called holy basil!
Tulsi is used in medicine and cooking!
Tulsi leaves smell wonderful!
Tulsi is a plant, not an animal!
